title: Scopoletin: A Validated Protector against Cerulein-induced Acute Pancreatitis & Associated Lung Injury by Regulating PPAR- gamma "A Multidimensional Approach".
authors: Brahadeeswaran, Subhashini; Chitluri, Kiran Kumar; George, Leema; Manickam, Venkatraman; Emerson, Isaac Arnold; Tamizhselvi, Ramasamy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究东莨菪内酯通过PPAR-γ信号通路减轻急性胰腺炎及肺损伤，分子对接仅针对小分子与PPAR-γ蛋白，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Our previous study established the effectiveness of scopoletin (SC) in protecting mice against acute pancreatitis (AP) induced by cerulein and subsequent pulmonary injury. However, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying SC protective effects have yet to be elucidated. This research suggests that SC reduces the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines and nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) by activating the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-gamma) in mice suffering from AP. We observed the protective role of SC against the male Swiss mice with hourly intraperitoneal injections of cerulein (50 microg/kg) for six hours, followed by the administration of SC (10 mg/kg) one hour after AP induction, with or without the PPAR-gamma antagonist GW9662 (0.3 mg/kg). The study exploration into the anti-inflammatory effects of SC revealed that a concentration of 25 microM enhanced the phagocytic clearance of dying pancreatic acinar cells by triggering the PPAR-gamma signaling activation. Conversely, an in vitro assessment confirmed the presence of GW9662 counteracted the beneficial impact of SC on acinar cells. Molecular docking and simulation studies have shown that SC prompts significant structural changes in PPAR-gamma. The in vivo, in vitro, and in silico analyses suggest that SC has potent anti-inflammatory properties that may be mediated by the activation of PPAR-gamma signaling in cerulein-induced experimental pancreatitis.
abstract_zh: 我们先前的研究确立了东莨菪内酯（scopoletin, SC）对雨蛙素（cerulein）诱导的急性胰腺炎（acute pancreatitis, AP）及后续肺损伤小鼠的保护作用。然而，SC保护效应背后的精确分子机制尚未阐明。本研究提示，SC通过激活过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma, PPAR-gamma）减少促炎细胞因子和核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa B, NF-kappaB）的释放，从而在AP小鼠中发挥作用。我们观察了SC对雄性瑞士小鼠的保护作用，这些小鼠每小时腹腔注射雨蛙素（50微克/公斤）共六小时，随后在AP诱导后一小时给予SC（10毫克/公斤），并联合或不联合PPAR-gamma拮抗剂GW9662（0.3毫克/公斤）。对SC抗炎效应的研究探索显示，25微摩尔浓度通过触发PPAR-gamma信号激活，增强了死亡胰腺腺泡细胞的吞噬清除作用。相反，体外评估证实，GW9662的存在抵消了SC对腺泡细胞的有益影响。分子对接和模拟研究表明，SC诱导PPAR-gamma发生显著结构变化。体内、体外及计算机模拟分析提示，SC具有强效抗炎特性，其可能通过激活PPAR-gamma信号在雨蛙素诱导的实验性胰腺炎中发挥作用。
